en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large, austere public building with arched ground-floor openings and many rectangular windows above. The facade bears the inscription "POSTE E TELEGRAFI," indicating it is a post and telegraph office. In front of the building is a busy open-air market with rows of stalls covered by fabric canopies and many people walking around. At the bottom margin of the image there is a printed caption identifying the location.
